Frequently Asked Questions
Does the C850 Gold support 12V-2x6 graphics cards?
Yes. The C850 Gold includes one 16-pin (12+4) 12V-2x6 PCIe cable and three 6+2-pin PCIe cables, each 650 mm long. The C850 Gold is an ATX 3.1 power supply, compliant with ATX12V v3.1 and EPS12V v2.92.
Does the C850 Gold have a zero RPM fan mode?
Yes. The C850 Gold has a Zero RPM Fan Mode that keeps its 135 mm fluid dynamic bearing fan stopped until system load reaches 50%. A button on the power supply turns the mode off if you want the fan spinning all the time.
How efficient is the C850 Gold?
The C850 Gold is rated 80 PLUS Gold. At 115 V, efficiency measures 89.5% at 20% load, 91.7% at 50% load and 89.2% at full load. Total output is 850 W, with up to 70.83 A available on the +12V rail.
Is the C850 Gold fully modular, and what cables are included?
Yes, the C850 Gold is fully modular. The box includes a 600 mm 24-pin ATX cable, 700 mm 4+4-pin and 8-pin CPU cables, three SATA cables with 12 SATA connectors in total, a peripherals cable with 4 connectors and an AC power cord.
How big is the C850 Gold, and what warranty does it have?
The C850 Gold measures 150 x 86 x 160 mm (W x H x D) in a standard ATX form factor and comes in white or black. NZXT covers the C850 Gold with a 10-year warranty.
